subject: Mutual-plan draft: RACI, milestone timeline, and close-path asks
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual-plan draft: RACI, milestone timeline, and close-path asks

Claire — thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (CB-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and a target close path. High level ask: can you confirm the ClearBridge stakeholders (economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, engineering lead) and that the proposed target close of 2026-08-06 is workable?

Summary (high level) — items in the attached spreadsheet:
- Milestone 1: POC scoping and success criteria — owner: ClearBridge Eng lead (proposed due 2026-06-30)
- Milestone 2: Security review & data flow diagram — owner: ClearBridge Security (proposed due 2026-07-12)
- Milestone 3: Commercial terms & procurement (SOW + PO) — owner: economic buyer / procurement (proposed due 2026-07-26)
- Milestone 4: Legal redlines + final SLA — owner: ClearBridge Legal (proposed due 2026-07-30)
- Redwood owners: Sales (Ben) for commercial; Security/solution (Karthik) for integrations; Legal (Marissa) for contract review.

Questions for you (please reply inline):
1) Confirm names / contact for economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, and engineering lead.
2) Any mandatory compliance gates or procurement lead times we should reflect in the timeline?
3) Are there any additional stakeholders to add to the MAP (e.g., cloud procurement, platform resiliency)?

I've also attached a short SOC2 highlights doc so your security reviewer can triage quickly. If we can get a confirmed RACI by end of next week, Ben and I will lock the milestone dates and circulate an updated MAP with final owners.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CB-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) ; redwood-soc2-highlights.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)
From: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@clearbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@clearbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual-plan draft: RACI, milestone timeline, and close-path asks

Vanessa — thanks, this is super helpful. Quick confirmation of owners on our side:
- Economic buyer: Tom Hale, VP Product (tom.hale@clearbridge.com) — will own procurement/commercial decisions
- Security owner: Raj Patel, Head of Security (raj.patel@clearbridge.com) — will lead security review and signoff
- Legal owner: Maya Singh, Sr. Counsel (maya.singh@clearbridge.com) — will manage contract/redlines
- Engineering lead: Samir Desai, Director of Integrations (samir.desai@clearbridge.com) — will own the POC and integration work

Two quick notes:
- We need the security review to include a brief runbook for data retention and key rotation. Raj will want the SOC2 highlights now (the PDF is useful) and then the SOC2 report if we proceed to the POC.
- Procurement typically needs ~3 weeks after commercial terms are agreed to issue a PO. If we keep target close 2026-08-06 that sounds tight but possible if legal and procurement work in parallel. Could we shift the internal legal due date to 2026-07-22 and commercial finalize by 2026-07-19? That gives procurement time.

I copied Tom so he can confirm final budget and procurement lead. I also attached a short internal checklist (not attached here) — we'll send anything Raj or Maya need after this note.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual-plan draft: RACI, milestone timeline, and close-path asks

Looping in our internal owners and a few clarifications after Claire's notes.
- Redwood commercial owner: Ben Carter (me) — will coordinate procurement timing and commercial terms.
- Redwood security/solution owner: Karthik Iyer — Karthik will be primary contact for Raj and will prepare a short integration runbook.
- Redwood legal lead: Marissa Cole — Marissa will triage contract redlines and can target quick turn if we get a clean starter SOW.

On timeline adjustments — shifting legal due date to 2026-07-22 and commercial finalize by 2026-07-19 works for us. If ClearBridge can confirm procurement lead time (~3 weeks) we should be aligned for the 2026-08-06 close.

Next actions (internal):
1) Karthik to prepare integration runbook + answers to likely security FAQ (target 2026-06-25).
2) Marissa to provision an initial SOW template for their review (target 2026-06-24).
3) Vanessa to update MAP with new legal/commercial dates and circulate to Claire/Tom.

I'll also note the HubSpot deal (CB-1129) and will update stages once we have RACI locked.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@clearbridge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual-plan draft: RACI, milestone timeline, and close-path asks

Claire / team — thanks for the clarity. Confirming Redwood owners and a few technical dependencies below.
- Redwood technical owner: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com) — will own the integration runbook and field security questions.
- Key dependencies:
  * ClearBridge to share network topology and sample dataset for POC by 2026-06-28 (we need it to size memory / KV cache expectations).
  * Raj -> will require an IP allowlist and confirmation of acceptable encryption-at-rest keys (we can support customer-managed KMS).

I attached a very short SOC2 highlights doc for Raj (redwood-soc2-highlights.pdf). If Raj wants the full report we'll route through our security team and NDA as needed.

I'll start the runbook and aim to have a draft by 2026-06-25. Vanessa — when you push the updated MAP can you set the milestone owners column to the confirmed names (Tom, Raj, Maya, Samir) and our owners (Ben, Karthik, Marissa)? I'll mark any technical risks in the runbook.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
